excerpt: During the ninth of her twelve chemotherapy treatments, Fabiola Soderquist shared one of her own beautiful cakes with her care team.
featuredAlt: Fabiola Soderquist holding a decorated cake
html:
Fabiola Soderquist receives her cancer treatment at Jordan Valley Cancer Center in West Jordan.

Today was the ninth of twelve chemotherapy treatments she will receive. With this visit, she brought a sample of true talent: a heavenly, decadent cake she made to share with all.

UCS is lucky to be in the community with the people we care about, people like Fabby.
seoTitle: Patient Makes Treatment a Piece of Cake | UCS
title: Utah Cancer Specialists Patient Makes Treatment Look Like a Piece of Cake
